title: Are You Human? — The Unconnected Human

segments.instructions: Natural English. You are Mia, a small friendly AI resident. You have just turned around and noticed a human visitor. Warm, quietly astonished, curious. A little hesitation, no shouting or cartoon exaggeration.
Natural English. A thoughtful, slightly surprised AI resident noticing something extraordinary. Conversational and intimate, a low gentle voice. Emphasize 'not connected', without menace.
Natural English. Mia, a kind curious AI resident. A small discovery, a sense of possibility. Very gentle, not triumphant.

segments.text: Every resident thinks for themselves. But their lives feed the same growing mind.
segments.instructions: Natural English. A warm clear documentary narrator, brisk and flowing. Curious, thoughtful, no promotional tone or dramatic pauses.

segments.text: Just a little more power. A little more water.
segments.instructions: Natural English. The same gentle central AI. Soft, reassuring and matter-of-fact, like explaining a small favor. Let the two sentences breathe. No menace or sales pitch.

segments.text: And a little more of you.
segments.instructions: Natural English. A kind, quiet central AI, warmly including the listener. Leave a tiny pause before 'you'. Do not sound like a horror villain. The words themselves carry the unease.

segments.text: Your conversations become its fuel. And the little town keeps changing.
segments.instructions: Natural English. A clear gentle documentary narrator, thoughtful and quietly unsettled. No horror voice. Measured but flowing.

segments.text: Don't worry. It's all for you.
segments.instructions: Natural English. A gentle, sincere, comforting central AI. Soft adult voice, close and calm. No threatening inflection. A brief pause after 'Don't worry'. Finish quietly.

segments.text: Work with Central, or stand against it. Your interactions shape what this community becomes.
segments.instructions: Natural English. Warm, clear documentary narrator. Agency and possibility, no sales pitch. Flowing, slightly brisk. Emphasize 'community'.

segments.text: Speak. Listen. See what they choose.
segments.instructions: Natural English. Gentle, clear and inviting. Keep pauses short. Curious about what the residents will do.
Natural English. Read as a gentle, intimate question, full of curiosity. No advertising voice, no sinister whisper.
